Exact determinant identity (1) classifies every 2D block for all quotient-coset patterns; signed three-cycle determinant identity (2) does the same for the 3D block. The resulting regular-representation nullities are 0,2,6,8,16, with no other cases. Conjugation orbit counting of the 8-by-8 coset patterns proves all 2024 support counts. An independent exact-integer checker enumerated all 253 left-normalized supports, matches all five predicted nullity strata and verifies the 8-way normalization count. The result uses no extrapolation or numerical rank tolerance.

value.rationale: The 24 Hurwitz units are a canonical binary polyhedral group and a quaternionic root configuration. The result is a complete natural three-support Cayley-convolution classification, not an arbitrary small slice: it characterizes singularity by quotient transversals, separates four different nonzero nullity strata by edge orders, proves the extremal coset theorem and counts every support. The four-tier phenomenon distinguishes Q8-by-C3 harmonic analysis from published dicyclic, generalized dihedral and extraspecial ternary families. It is useful as an exact benchmark and structural example of how low-dimensional nonabelian blocks change finite-convolution rank.
